checks.name: required_assets
checks.requirement: all masters, data, QA, and archive sources exist

checks.name: png_dimensions
checks.requirement: PNG pixels match final size at 600 dpi

checks.name: svg_vector_text
checks.requirement: SVG is vector and keeps editable text

checks.name: qa_dimensions
checks.requirement: QA surfaces match final print size at 180 dpi

checks.name: panel_a_formula
checks.requirement: Panel A samples the exact scalar formula

checks.name: panel_b_formula
checks.requirement: Panel B samples the fixed-geometry exponent ledger

checks.name: certificate_crosscheck
checks.requirement: producer and independent certificate crosscheck passes

checks.name: frozen_constant_trend
checks.requirement: finite frozen ratios rise monotonically and end within 25 percent of 16/pi^2; this is diagnostic only

checks.name: dissipative_two_routes
checks.requirement: Panel D contains two four-case finite diagnostic routes

checks.name: source_lineage
checks.requirement: all source hashes retain build lineage

checks.name: output_lineage
checks.requirement: all figure outputs retain build hashes

checks.name: claim_boundary
checks.requirement: caption and contract separate proof from diagnostics and the Clay problem

checks.name: visual_inspection_declared
checks.requirement: final-size, grayscale, and PDF raster were explicitly inspected
